merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary (≤150 words)** - **Vineyard:** 18 ha on clay‑flint; 11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc. - **Production:** ~62 000 bottles / yr; 2024 output 48 000 after May hail that *likely* reduced the western plots by about 20 % (≈ one‑fifth). - **Certification:** Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion started 2023, earliest certification 2026. - **Exports:** 41 % of volume (main markets Belgium, Japan). Japan limits sulphites to < 60 mg/L. - **Past issues:** * 2022 Tank 4 controller drift cost €11 000 – now calibrated pre‑harvest with a second probe. * 2023 label/mislabelling error recalled 900 bottles – proofs now require two signatures. - **Operational rules:** No irrigation on western plots; harvest dates fixed after three consecutive mornings of sugar / acidity readings; any tank exceeding 28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - **Open items (uncertain):** Lighter‑weight bottles – importer
